fluff.overview: Manei Domini infantry squads operate in small, heavily augmented formations where every trooper carries cybernetic enhancements tailored to their combat role, from enhanced optics and communicator implants to dermal armor and prosthetic weapon mounts. Domini foot infantry operate as small, self-contained kill teams whose cybernetic enhancements compensate for their reduced squad sizes. Each trooper carries augmentations that make them individually more dangerous than a full squad of conventional soldiers. Equipped with compact laser weapons optimized for reconnaissance operations, these troops trade raw firepower for a lighter loadout that supports extended independent patrols behind enemy lines.
